message: I remember the time I was caught in a surprise blackout during a movie marathon. I frantically searched for my flashlight, only to find it was dead—just like my popcorn ambitions. After rummaging through drawers, I ended up using my phone flashlight to navigate the kitchen and grab snacks. It was a bit of a comedy show, but it reminded me how important it is to keep power banks charged and have a few reliable light sources handy. Ever had a moment like that when you were completely unprepared?
